policy_title: 关于进一步完善研发费用税前加计扣除政策的公告
issuer: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration
conditions: Eligible R&D activities and expense categories; excluded industries remain excluded under Cai Shui [2015] 119.
Maintain project records and separate R&D expense accounts; accounting R&D is not automatically eligible tax R&D.
benefits: An additional 100% deduction of eligible expensed R&D; eligible intangible assets amortized at 200% of cost.
summary: A potential R&D deduction opportunity. Eligibility and expense reconciliation require human review.

policy_title: 高新技术企业减按15％税率征收企业所得税（官方政策指引）
reference: Enterprise Income Tax Law, Article 28(2); Guo Ke Fa Huo [2016] 32
conditions: Valid high-tech qualification and compliance with continuing recognition requirements.
Technology personnel, multi-year R&D ratios, IP, qualifying product revenue and other conditions all require verification.
benefits: Qualifying high-tech enterprises apply a 15% CIT rate.
summary: Recognition is a prerequisite; an innovation score cannot establish legal eligibility.

policy_title: 关于进一步支持小微企业和个体工商户发展有关税费政策的公告
issuer: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration
conditions: Annual taxable income ≤ RMB 3m; employees ≤ 300; total assets ≤ RMB 50m; not in restricted/prohibited industries.
Employee and asset tests use the prescribed annual quarterly averages; year-end values only support preliminary screening.
benefits: 25% of taxable income is taxed at 20%, equivalent to a 5% effective rate for qualifying income.
summary: Book profit is not taxable income. This system screens candidates and asks for quarterly-average evidence.

policy_title: 关于先进制造业企业增值税加计抵减政策的公告
issuer: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration
applicable_entities: Listed advanced manufacturing general VAT taxpayers
conditions: Manufacturing general taxpayers with high-tech qualification AND inclusion in the competent authority's approved list.
Use eligible deductible input VAT; export/cross-border attributable input VAT is excluded; reconcile carryovers.
benefits: Additional VAT credit of 5% of eligible deductible input VAT, subject to policy rules.
summary: High-tech status alone is insufficient. Approved-list status is a separate evidence requirement.

policy_title: 关于增值税法施行后增值税优惠政策衔接事项的公告（小规模纳税人部分）
issuer: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration
reference: MOF / STA Announcement 2026 No. 10, Sections I and III(3)(6)
conditions: Monthly/quarterly/transaction taxation periods have distinct thresholds; special invoice and waiver rules need review.
The 1% concession covers specified 3%-levy transactions, excluding sale/lease of immovable property and transfer of land use rights.
benefits: Monthly RMB 100k / quarterly RMB 300k / per-day RMB 1k thresholds; eligible 3%-levy transactions reduced to 1% during 2026–2027.
summary: A 2026 forward-looking opportunity; not applied retrospectively to FY2025 enterprise tax records.

policy_title: 深圳市工业和信息化局关于开展2026年高新技术企业认定工作的通知
issuer: Shenzhen Industry and Information Technology Bureau
conditions: Technology personnel ≥10%; three-year R&D/sales ratios ≥5%, 4% or 3% by latest sales size.
Domestic R&D ≥60%; qualifying product/service revenue ≥60%; IP, innovation evaluation and other conditions apply.
Published application batches closed 6 July, 3 August and 4 September 2026 (18:00). Current availability must not be inferred.
benefits: Recognition process supporting access to qualifying high-tech tax treatment; not a cash grant.
summary: Archived notice: the final published application batch closed on 4 September 2026. Retained for recognition-readiness research; not a current application opportunity.

policy_title: 深圳市发布科技金融行动方案：15条措施支持未来产业高质量发展
issuer: Shenzhen Municipal Government portal (official report of eight-department action plan)
conditions: Directional financing framework, not an entitlement or lending approval.
Confirm current product availability, project lists, lender criteria and any programme-specific deadlines.
benefits: Encourages technology investment financing and better coordination of equity and credit services.
summary: Use innovation evidence to start a financing-needs discussion, subject to independent diligence.

policy_title: “税银携手 以信赋能”——广东举办“银税互动”合作签约仪式
issuer: State Taxation Administration, Guangdong Provincial Tax Service
conditions: An official collaboration report, not a statutory eligibility or guaranteed loan rule.
Enterprise-authorized data sharing, lender product criteria and independent credit review are required.
benefits: Tax-credit information can support conversations about inclusive financing.
summary: A relationship-manager lead for verification; no approved borrowing amount is inferred.
